notes.title: First Anniversary -- Release 1.6
notes.content:
[h1]FULL PATCH NOTES:[/h1]
[list]
[*] ---CHANGES
[*] Added volumetric fog to high debris areas
[*] Updated the main ship model and materials
[*] Updated some materials
[*] Updated some models
[*] Added emissive decals to some objects
[*] Added air particles when opening the damaged airlock
[*] Added a yellow light in the player ship to show where ice is added
[*] Moved some rocks
[*] Improved the look of the UI
[*] Added different waypoint colours for different storylines
[*] Made the lab a source of music alongside the player ship
[*] Added some extra lights to help guide the player
[*] Increased effectiveness of oxygen recyclers
[*] Changed main menu background
[*] Normalised some dialougue
[*] The mainlight now gets more intense over time

[*] ---BUG FIXES
[*] Fixed an issue where some items wouldn't recieve the sonar effect
[*] Fixed an issue where the camera could become misaligned after hitting objects
[*] Fixed a bunch of other things but wasn't sure if it was from me breaking everything or if it was already there

[*] ---BEHIND THE SCENES
[*] Improved the player script
[*] Improved old and bad code
[*] Removed placeholder text while showing crafting recipes
[*] Added a command for playing in game music
[*] Improved playing music
[*] Improved harvesting and picking up objects
[*] Improved waypoints
[*] Made the debug console only able to be opened while the pause/inventory menu is open
[/list]

notes.title: 1.5 Patch 5
notes.content:
[h1]FULL PATCH NOTES:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where upon dying with respawn enabled and the ship had no oxygen you would be stuck on a black screen
[*] Added a new death type to reflect these changes
[*] Added the external laboratory module to the introduction and tutorial scene
[*] Added some dialogue in the introduction to reflect the laboratory
[*] Fixed an issue where an error could occur on clicks after finishing the tutorial
[/list]

notes.title: 1.5 Patch 4
notes.content:
[h1]FULL PATCH NOTES:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changed stopping input so now holding stop will automatically stop when possible
[*] Changed the model of the active radiation shielding debris structure
[*] Changed location of blackbox collectible
[*] Changed material and shape of aurora around radiation shielding structure
[*] Intensity of the aurora around the radiation shielding now scales over time
[*] Changed dialogue relating to the warp core and active radiation shielding
[*] Stars now explode or fizzle out, at a higher frequency over time to represent time dilation
[*] Updates to spawning stars at the start of a level
[*] Stars now also spawn at different sizes
[*] Fixed an issue where the explosion particle system for each star would play on awake causing a lag spike
[*] Added the 'star' command to pick a random star and either destroy or explode it
[*] Changed the hangar model in the introduction
[*] Changed the model of the player ship
[*] Changed lcoations of fixable objects on player ship
[*] Changed location of some asteroid pieces around the player ship
[*] Relocated some areas
[*] Added sounds for a variety of interactions
[*] Added small pitch variation for repetitive sounds
[*] Added camera shake for big impacts with walls
[*] Fixed some issues where certain sounds weren't affected by changing in-game volume
[*] Added ambient particles
[/list]

notes.title: 1.5 Patch 3
notes.content:
FULL PATCH NOTES:
[list]
[*] Changes to black hole path
[*] significantly improved performance when the black hole covers a large portion of the screen (up to 4x framerate)
[*] Fixed a visual issue where the crafting materials display list would not account for items in storage
[/list]

notes.title: 1.5 Patch 2
notes.content:
[h1]FULL PATCH NOTES:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changed rendering order
[*] Fixed an issue where you would be unable to open storage when the ship or lab had no oxygen
[*] Changed the items command so it now shows the display name of each item, changed the add item command to take in the display names
[*] Added a clear command to clear all inventories
[*] Added a die command
[*] Fixed issues with "ghost items" persisting through runs and causing the inventory to break
[*] OpenXR no longer initialises on startup
[/list]

notes.title: 1.5 Patch 1
notes.content:
[h1]FULL PATCH NOTES:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a missing glass material in the tutorial
[*] Changed sonar battery to sonar recharger, changed sonar uptime upgrade to sonar coolers
[*] Fixed an issue so now the display names are shown on the temp item when dragging an object in an inventory
[*] Changed the temp item's text component from legacy so it doesn't appear blurry
[*] Fixed an issue where stopping would still work while paused in the menu
[*] Fixed an issue where the effects of sonar would persist in menu and introductions if present when the game ended
[*] Changed rendering order
[/list]

[h1]ISSUES:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Inventory issue relating to a bug similar to one in pre-release
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.5 Notes
notes.content:
[h1]FULL PATCH NOTES:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added second ending
[list]
[*]  	new milestone types
[*]  	new milestones
[*]  	new ships
[*]  	new areas
[*]  	new sounds
[/list]
[*] Complete rework of milestone system
[*] Changed text the finish/death screen unique to each ending
[*] Changed the way finishing the game is calculated
[*] Normalised names of visible waypoints
[*] Changed all dialogue (I totally didn't forget to save it while I reworked it)
[*] Added collectibles
[*] Added achievement for collecting all collectibles
[*] Added achievement for completing the second ending
[*] Added more items and recipes
[*] Changed the description of some debug commands
[*] Changed the cycle_milestone command
[*] Pressing escape closes the debug console
[*] Dropped items now keep player velocity
[*] Using sonar now displays the distance to the object at the centre of the screen
[*] The speed of the player is now displayed next to the direction marker
[*] Removed the crafting menu in the tutorial
[*] Rearranged the main menu background to reflect the update
[*] Added a toggle to the main menu to load straight to the game instead of skipping all intros individually
[*] Added an alarm to the player ship disabled by repairing systems
[*] Fixed an issue where a death screen could sometimes appear upon winning
[*] Fixed an issue where you were unable to harvest some large asteroids
[*] Fixed issues where the player would still use fuel when moving and stopping when near some surfaces
[*] Fixed an issue where you could sometimes not craft an item if you had more than you needed or materials were split
[*] Fixed an issue where it would still display the text to fix an object after it had been fixed
[*] Fixed an issue where fixable objects would ask for the correct item but using the wrong (internal) name
[*] Fixed some issues of wrong materials
[*] Fixed more issues of excessive shininess
[/list]

notes.title: 1.4 Patch 1
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the game couldn't be won

notes.title: Update 1.4 Notes
notes.content:
[h1]FULL PATCH NOTES:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added internal HDR Rendering
[*] Fixed some instances of excessive shininess
[*] Fixed some instances of incorrect materials
[*] Increased intensity of lens flares
[*] Changes to post processing
[*] Changes to support openXR and VR
[*] Changes to outline shader to support HDR
[*] Specular highlights disabled on some materials

notes.title: Update 1.3 Notes
notes.content:
[h2]FULL PATCH NOTES:[/h2]
[list]
[*] fixed an issue where you couldn't win the game
[*] Added debug/cheat console, enabled with ` on keyboard only and enter to submit, use 'help' to display commands
[*] Added 2 keybinds for keyboard only, relating to debug console
[*] fixed backend issues relating to the RCS default value
[*] fixed some readability issues in the finish screen
[*] fixed an issue where the version indicator in the main menu was behind by 1 update
[/list]
[h2]NOT YET FIXED:[/h2]
[list]
[*] V-Sync toggle sometimes not working (i've actually got no idea)
[*] Due to the way the scene renders, while using the simulated black hole, the explosion particles that are far away from the player at the time will not render.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.2 Notes
notes.content:
This update mainly brings refinements to some game aspects.
[h2]FULL PATCH NOTES:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed finishing position of black hole
[*] Added explosions on ship pieces during the final moments of the game
[*] Fixed an issue where two asteroid piece names displayed as the wrong text, changed to 'Large Metallic Asteroid'
[*] Fixed a consistency issue where both rock and ice debris displayed as asteroid pieces. Now, ice debris displays as 'Comet Piece' and rocky debris displays as 'Asteroid Piece'
[*] Resource scanner range increased from 80 > 150, advanced resource scanner range increased from 200 > 300
[*] Fixed a backend issue where the advanced resource scanner was named 'AdvancedResourceScanner 1'
[*] Some dialogues now show tips for finding certain items.
[*] Fixed an issue where dragging and dropping identical items together in the inventory wouldn't update the text stats relating to that slot.
[/list]
[h2]NOT YET FIXED:[/h2]
[list]
[*] V-Sync toggle sometimes not working
[*] Due to the way the scene renders, while using the simulated black hole, the explosion particles that are far away from the player at the time will not render.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1 Notes - Respawns
notes.content:
[h2]FULL PATCH NOTES:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added respawns
[*] Respawn toggle in the Main Menu
[*] Respawning drops items in inventory (not equipment), the items no longer fly away if they spawned clipped into an object
[*] Respawning loses a set amount of time
[*] Added ability to craft from ship storage, crafting materials list displays total items from both inventories
[*] Added tonemapping as a post processing effect (lights are no longer incredibly bright up close and super dark everywhere else)
[*] Torch upgrade range increased from 20 > 30, intensity increased from 5 > 15, reduced colour temperature
[*] Saturation post processing effect increased from -32 > -19
[*] Tutorial now shows a "press _ to skip", skip button moved from settings to main inventory
[*] Reduced thruster power by 15%
[*] Reduced thruster fuel usage by 50%
[*] Increased first RCS upgrade power from 10% > 15%
[*] Fixed an issue where some settings wouldn't have their effect at the start of the game
[/list]
[h2]NOT YET FIXED:[/h2]
[list]
[*] V-Sync toggle sometimes not working
[*] Dragging and dropping identical item stacks on top of each other doesn't update the amount and weight (the items are not lost)
[/list]
